launch_slurm_job: submit a FairChem job to a SLURM cluster using submitit with AutoExecutor and scheduler config
launch_local_job: launch a FairChem job locally using torch elastic launch or single process mode
create_slurm_spmd_program: instantiate a SlurmSPMDProgram checkpointable entrypoint for SPMD jobs launched via submitit on SLURM
map_job_to_dist_config: convert a JobConfig into a distributed training config dict with world size and backend settings
remove_runner_state_from_submission: decouple a SLURM job submission from runner state to prevent stale checkpoint resubmission on node failure
